title: Not what I expected. Very random and not for me.
text: I gave the Allure Box 3 stars because of the two full sized products that I received. Sadly, they don't ask questions before mailing a box so half of the items in there were not for me. The cosmetic bag in red came ripped apart and someone used tape to keep it together! The items inside were definitely worth over $100, and I paid $10 so I won't bash it too much. I also didn't receive what was in the booklet it came with. I cancelled but got charged again and no box came. I  was told I'll get my money back in on or two statements. Personally, I would not recommend.
label: neutral
